_why: Veto caps for the cost tier, CALIBRATED against the shipped app before the first graded run rather than guessed. A floor set below the app you already ship is a bar you end up moving at 3am to make a number look better.
_measured: DM shell at 390x844, all five lenses plus Settings: choices 5-21, distinct numbers 0-33, minimum font 10px on every screen.

reach._choice_note: observed max 21 (World). Set one notch above so a real regression trips it and today's app does not.
reach._number_note: observed max 33 (Story). Stage legitimately shows ~22 for a fight, which is why this is not tighter.
reach._legibility_note: NOT a veto. The app's own floor is 10px everywhere, so vetoing on 13px rejected every screen. minFontPx is reported per row instead.
